researchConsequences: Add same-scale color/one-color review of the whole cluster to mechanical proof, without treating it as GD acceptance.
Explore a meaningful enclosing frame, shared stem or bar across regions. Ablate its pins and split the rigid part to distinguish true joint movement from an independent assembly.
Consider core geometry and logical link contacts separately; never infer containment merely from a visibly open arc.
Do not copy site counts, replay calls, thresholds, source order or website instructions into gameplay/campaign rules. Continue with supplied Designer, no Unity replay or HTML.
